_comment: Reference scripts block for a client repo. `npm run check` is REQUIRED by the Definition of Done in CLAUDE.md and gates integration-merge — it must exist in every client project. qa-devops merges this into the project's package.json during setup; adjust the individual commands to the project's actual tooling, but keep the `check` entry point identical so the DoD and the merge gate always resolve.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
